additional_concerns: The candidate has no executable formalization. Retrieval success and the unsupported LegalRuleML result establish no legal or executable fidelity.

Retained accountability, supervisory conduct and satisfactory operational outcomes are distinct. The supplied text establishes neither a supervision safe harbour nor automatic failure of retained accountability following any operational failure.

Clause 6.8 allocates register maintenance to specified parties; clause 6.11C concerns third-party valuation. Neither supplies a universal Product Provider fulfilment test. The issuance responsibility provision also has its own intermediary activity conditions.

Paragraph 14 most directly conditions demonstration on an SFC request, while confirmation has no express request trigger. Footnote 5 leaves the demonstration-trigger relationship and breadth of the confidence standard unresolved. Paragraphs 15 and 16 expressly condition obtaining audit or verification and legal opinion on request.

The referenced Appendix Parts A and B, the complete paragraphs 10–13 and footnote 2 are not supplied. Their applicable content would be needed before claiming a complete substantive compliance standard; no external dependency IDs are supplied.
No actual authority arrangements, supervision evidence, operational results or ownership records are supplied. The provider's satisfaction of the assessed requirement remains unresolved.
